Extreme close-up painted still at a lamplit banquet, shallow focus. A single ripe peach, fat and blushing rose-gold, held up in the frame by the tips of two fingers and a thumb, the cleft of the peach turned to camera. One side of its skin is sucked wet and glossy, the soft flesh just broken at the top so it gleams, a heavy bead of golden juice swelling at the lowest point and a thin wet line already run down over the knuckles to the inside of the wrist, where the frayed cuff of a washed-out green jeogori sleeve and a twist of red sash cloth just enter the frame. Nothing else of her. Behind, a blur of banquet lamps as warm bokeh and a lacquer tray of more peaches. ONE device: the bead of juice about to drop, lit like a jewel. Sage-green #8AAFA0 and rose-gold, warm lamp key. PAINTED STILL — no people, no figures, no faces, no hands anywhere in the frame; the place or object IS the subject. Openly erotic metaphor: the shapes, wetness, swelling, thrusting and release unmistakably read as bodies and sex, the way a frank erotic painting does — yet everything stays landscape and object, no nudity, no literal anatomy. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). Hand-painted WATERCOLOR-AND-OIL: granulated wet-in-wet washes and broken-colour dabs for sky, water and stone, dry-brush texture, soft bleeding edges and a faint paper grain; oil glazes deepen the darks and a touch of impasto lands on the single brightest highlight. Romantic-painting layout: one bold shape, at least half the frame quiet negative space, distant detail dissolving into haze. Film tenebrism: one hard directional key (sun, moon or lamp) against big dark masses, a thin edge of real light along the subject, painted bokeh from small real lights. Beautiful, luminous, painterly. NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, NOT a cartoon. No text. No watermark. NIGHT GROUND: the frame is built on BLACK — crushed ink-black night masses around the subject, the place pulled out of the dark only where the one key light (fire, lamp, torch, moon) falls, small warm bokeh in the black; the figure is the bright thing in a dark frame.
